result.decision_reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): Both expressions are understandable, but the card overstates the contrast. Indonesian “sahabat karib” means a close/intimate friend and is suitable for the stated sense. Malaysian “kawan baik” commonly means a good friend and does not reliably convey “best” or closest friend. Neither form is exclusive to one variety, so the claimed different-common-word relation is misleading. No false-friend contrast is present. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
